final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/worker.log by reading it line by line and identifying log entries using a regex pattern for the entry header line. I included only entries with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive). For each such entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required ISO format, extracted the service, level (uppercased), and message (text after the last separator). I also accounted for repeated messages by summing the counts from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. I collected all these error entries in a list and computed counts by service summing the repeat counts. The results were written to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure.
